Unnamed: 1: AMG-114 is a hyperglycosylated version of Aranesp (sialylated rEPO). It has additional covalently-attached carbohydrate groups.
One animal study showed the effect of treatment was sustained for 21 days postinjection, compared to 12 days for Aranesp and 7 days for Epogen.
In Late 2004,Amgen plans to initiate p1/2 studies of 114 in chemo-induced anemia. The company has promised rapid development.
131-hr half life as per ASCO 2006 abstract title - 200mcg q3w study
